summary: Brunswick County Schools opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate funding, emphasizing the cost implications for maintaining school services. The school district currently receives significant E-Rate funding to cover 90% of Category One WAN infrastructure expenses and 85% of Category Two expenses annually. Without E-Rate funding, the school would need to cover the full cost of these services, which would be financially burdensome. The school district emphasizes the importance of preserving the core E-Rate program and supports thoughtful improvements, simplification, and fraud prevention, but urges the FCC to avoid changes that would reduce access, increase administrative burden, or limit local flexibility for schools and students.
